messages:
sam: Quick check — our biweekly release train for eng-runtime + eng-platform lands the week that overlaps with the UK public holiday. Current cutoff is Fri Jan 9. Can we shift the train earlier or split components? Any blockers?

devon: leaning toward shifting the train 48h earlier so CI windows don't hit the holiday. that means cutoff -> Wed Jan 7. Is that feasible for platform?

anya: Wed Jan 7 is tight for a couple infra patches (kv-cache hotfix + telemetry change). we could cut those to next train but need to flag changelog and version bump.

priya: noted. can you list the PRs that'd move? i'll ping reviewers and do a quick sweep for any breaking deps.

chris: FYI, customer-facing docs team is on PTO Jan 8-12. If we squeeze the train earlier, they'll miss the changelog review window. we can ship the release without the docs landing, but we should add a note in the release description.

sam: good catch. options: 1) shift train 48h earlier (cutoff Wed 7, release Fri 9) but docs will miss review; 2) split train: runtime goes earlier, platform stays on original cadence; 3) keep dates and accept holiday bridge (ops on-call covers). pros/cons?

devon: split seems safest — runtime has low-risk deltas, platform has infra patches and needs longer review. also avoids tripping the docs team's outage.

anya: agree with split. we'll need to create a separate branch for the runtime-only train and update the release calendar. branching plan:
```
# branch plan
runtime/train/2026-01-09 -> cut from main on Mon Jan 5
platform/train/2026-01-09 -> keep cutoff Fri Jan 9
cherry-picks: infra-hotfix -> platform/train only
```

priya: I'll open the runtime branch and add a note in the PR templates tagging @chris for docs follow-up. also will add a changelog nudge label (release:urgent) to runtime PRs.

release-bot: Reminder: release calendar event updated by @priya — runtime train scheduled 2026-01-09 (runtime-only). Platform train remains 2026-01-09 (full) with original cutoff. See /releases calendar for details. :calendar:

chris: thanks. I'll mark the docs review as optional for runtime and prepare a short post-release note for customers.

sam: one more operational thing — can we get an ops fallback plan in case platform rollouts hit rate limits while support is thin?

ops-bot: Ops runbook check: if platform rollout exceeds latency SLA, automatic rollback to previous model variant will trigger. On-call will be paged. Please confirm playbook covers the split-train flow.

anya: confirmed. added a quick checklist to the release runbook and linked it in the platform PR description.

priya: pinging reviewers now. will update the calendar and changelog checklist when branches are cut.

devon: thanks everyone — i'll prepare the canary plan for runtime-only train and post the rollout schedule here once finalized. :rocket:

sam: all good. closing this thread after devon posts the canary schedule. :thumbsup:
